newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Lonrho shares tumble after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho shares tumble after profit warning.

text.p: Lonrho Ltd shares traded on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange fell after the firm, which is also listed in London, warned that its first half results could be down by about a third.
"As the profit warning came out the guys hit it. The London guys have been aggressive sellers," a dealer said.
The share reached a low of 990 cents -- a 10.1 percent slide -- after the warning before ending 60 cents lower, or 5.9 percent, at 10.30 rand.
Volume was heavy with more than two million shares changing hands, valued at 22 million rand.

Lonrho Plc said in a statement that the strength of sterling, poor precious metal prices, lower profits at Ashanti and moderate results in its African trading businesses would "adversely affect the results of the companies continuing businesses".
Dealers said futures play pushed the share up in early trade but it recovered in the afternoon before being hit by the profit warning.
